notes.title: The Prince Joins the Fight for Etheria!
notes.content:
We've just reached our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chromaticgames/defenders-of-etheria]Kickstarter's[/url] first stretch goal! Thanks to your incredible support, the [i]Prince of Dragonfall[/i] will join the fight against the Old One’s Army as a playable character in Defenders of Etheria! 

We figured that since the Old One’s Army is soon to receive a close-up of the Prince’s gauntlets, so should you (albeit in a less physical sense)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544618/79497717daee6895151225bf2a55faf611814441.png[/img]
We’ve already explored a handful of designs for the Prince’s arsenal. We want you, our players, to feel involved and rewarded as you climb through different tiers of gear rarity, so what does that mean for our designers? This means that when designing equipment of increasing rarity, we incorporate more unique materials, subtle (and not-so-subtle) thematic elements, eye-catching visual effects, and an emphasis on distinctive silhouette design to differentiate these pieces from prior rarity tiers. You may begin your journey swinging modest, fur-lined mittens, but you may very well end up hurling gilded Etherian relics, shrieking with the souls of departed adventurers, at your foes, who are now [i]also[/i] shrieking.

We’re incredibly grateful for the reception Defenders of Etheria has received so far. We're hard at work crafting vibrant, chaotic battlefields for your adventures to take place in, and we can't wait to show you some soon!

Our next stretch goal reward is the [i]Drakenfrost Region[/i], whose desolate, sleet-covered ruins will surely send a chill up even the most seasoned defenders' spines. To see this eternal winter engulf Etheria would warm our hearts, and we’re confident we can achieve this goal with your support! Our campaign still has [i]30 days to go[/i], so please share Etheria’s call for heroes far and wide.

Check out the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chromaticgames/defenders-of-etheria]Etheria Defenders of Kickstarter Campaign[/url] for additional information!

For Etheria!

notes.title: Defenders of Etheria is LIVE on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[h2]DoE is Live on Kickstarter![/h2]
Defenders! We're proud to announce the [i]Defenders of Etheria[/i] Kickstarter campaign is LIVE until [b]May 18th[/b]!

By backing the game on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chromaticgames/defenders-of-etheria]Kickstarter[/url], you can take advantage of [i]early-bird discounts[/i], [i]franchise-wide game and DLC bundles[/i] and earn [i]backer-exclusive rewards[/i] for both [i]Defenders of Etheria[/i] AND [i]Dungeon Defenders 2[/i]!

Miss our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/236110?emclan=103582791434161031&emgid=512950040394727465]original announcement[/url]? Not to worry, we've included a short recap below, and you can find additional information on our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chromaticgames/defenders-of-etheria]Kickstarter page[/url]!

[h2]What is Defenders of Etheria?[/h2]
It’s about time the Old One’s Army played defense! Enraged by the death of his father at the hands of the Harbinger, the Prince of Dragonfall has enlisted Etheria’s mightiest heroes to lead a crusade against the Old One’s Army. 

[previewyoutube=7D78OHEDsSk;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Defenders of Etheria[/i] won’t be your traditional tower-defense game (not that Dungeon Defenders was very traditional to begin with), but a [b]cooperative[/b], [b]rogue-lite bullet-heaven[/b] with all the added charm and stoicism of your favorite mostly-silent protagonists!

[h2]Wishlist DoE on Steam![/h2]
Looking for other ways to support [i]Defenders of Etheria[/i]? By wishlisting us on Steam, you can help us gain additional visibility for the game while receiving notifications regarding updates and availability. It’s a win-win!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647870/Defenders_of_Etheria/

[h2]Join the Discussion![/h2]
You can follow the progress of [i]Defenders of Etheria[/i] by following [i]us[/i] on [url=https://www.facebook.com/DungeonDefenders]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Chromatic_Games]X (formerly known as Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/chromatic_games/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@chromatic_games]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6rak1lOnwEAvajI5QY65nQ]YouTube[/url], and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/Chromatic_Games]Twitch[/url]! Additionally, you can join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/dd2]Official Dungeon Defenders Discord[/url], or participate in the community-driven [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/dungeondefenders/]Dungeon Defenders Reddit[/url].

For Etheria!
